context_menu.label: show the current function body again

reconcile_note: The start body already shows both in-body command sinks are popen on the fixed literal '/sbin/hwclock -r', with clienttime (*(iVar2+4)) going only to (a) strncpy field-slices that build a date string written via Set_Private_Profile_String (config write, not a command) and (b) the callee Set_Current_Date_Time. So the only fact not decidable from the start body is the behaviour of that callee. Delivering ctx/callee_Set_Current_Date_Time.c shows clienttime is consumed field-by-field, each field atoi-coerced to an int for settimeofday, and that the callee's only two system() calls use fixed rodata constants ('/sbin/hwclock --systohc' and '/etc/init.d/crond.sh restart ...'). No clienttime byte reaches any command, which resolves the terminal to not-vulnerable. The in-body popen constant is proven by the start body itself and is not marked on-target (it would only re-show start-body content and would inflate request_precision).
